decision_needed.question: General Fund 2710 'Property' 250,000 (Schedule M p28) exactly equals the Depreciation Fund 'Allocation from General Fund' 250,000 (p17), but nothing on the pages says the General Fund line is the transfer. Should it be treated as a transfer (as recorded) rather than student transportation spending plus other receipts?

notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds are governmental (School Nutrition and Activities are within the governmental funds statement, Exhibit III). Receipts/disbursements from Exhibit III Total Governmental Funds column (pp7, 9, 11); beginning/ending balance 7,877,989.70 / 5,735,102.91 (p11, ending also p1). Reconciles: 7,877,989.70 + 8,958,769.29 - 11,101,656.08 = 5,735,102.91. Local Receipts (4,382,089.65) split into categories by summing fund schedules (pp13, 19-22), items marked computed; fund-by-fund components add to the printed Local line. Attempt 2: penalties and interest on taxes (11,688.00) split out of property tax; carline split now category Carline Tax; activity income 206,677.42 -> Extracurricular Receipts and preschool tuition 3,647.59 -> Tuition Received, rest of fees stays charges for services; County Receipts 29,242.44 split into 2110 Fines and Licenses 14,392.93 and 2210 ESU Receipts 14,849.51 (p13); State Receipts 3,233,127.50 split into Homestead Exemption, Property Tax Credit, Motor Vehicle Pro-Rate and remaining state aid using the General, Bond and Nutrition fund schedules (pp13, 20, 21); Instruction-Related Technology (2230) moved to support services/Staff and Purchasing Services (2520) to Business, matching Schedule M. Non-Revenue Receipts 260,764.74 split into the 250,000 Depreciation allocation (transfer in) plus General Fund items on p14. Hidden transfer: 250,000 treated as transfer out of 2710 Vehicle Operation & Purchasing - Regular Education (368,895.78 printed -> 118,895.78 spending); printed totals kept and include transfers. Debt Service split principal/interest from Schedule H. Balance sheet (attempt 2, user rule 2026-10-27): governmental funds statement Exhibit III, Total Governmental Funds column (pp10-11 spread; amounts p11), fund balance by classification (Committed, Assigned, Unassigned); its total 5,735,102.91 equals the government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1); no liabilities printed. County Treasurers' Balance is Cash and Cash Equivalents. Detail: Schedule M (General Fund by object, program) supersedes Schedule B (function-only), so Schedule B and Schedule A-1 not recorded; budget_final only available at program-total level so object lines have null. Schedule A line 4525 Federal Vocational has budget only (10,000) and no actual, so omitted. Object mapping: Other Property Services -> professional/contract services, Purchased Property Services -> repairs and maintenance, Other Items -> dues, training and travel. Schedule N (County Treasurers' General Fund, p31) is a pass-through of the same General Fund tax receipts and not recorded again. Employee Benefit and Activities fund schedules have no printed receipt/expenditure totals so detail_totals omitted for them. Statement of Activities (pp2-5) not used for items; its Transfers label appears misaligned with columns. Read pages 1-31 of 31
